name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.noticesystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: The red-dot badge prefab with the NoticeItem component. Drop it under a button/tab as the icon node, assign your graphic, then register conditions on it at runtime.
Demonstrates custom NoticeCondition classes, a static condition-register class, RegisterNotice/RenewNotice with value- and reference-type data, and NoticeManager.Notify-driven badge refresh.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the NoticeSystem: NoticeCondition authoring, NoticeItem registration, and Notify-driven red-dot refresh. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
